title: Formal fibres of a polynomial ring over a complete local ring at a maximal ideal over the closed point
statement: Let $(S,\mathfrak n)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring which is $\mathfrak n$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], let $S[x]$ be the polynomial ring in one variable over $S$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and let $\mathfrak Q\subset S[x]$ be a maximal ideal with $\mathfrak Q\cap S=\mathfrak n$. Let $S[x]_{\mathfrak Q}$ be the localization of $S[x]$ at $\mathfrak Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $(S[x]_{\mathfrak Q})^\wedge=\varprojlim_nS[x]_{\mathfrak Q}/\mathfrak Q^nS[x]_{\mathfrak Q}$ its completion at its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the canonical map $S[x]_{\mathfrak Q}\to(S[x]_{\mathfrak Q})^\wedge$ is a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]; equivalently (it is flat with Noetherian fibre rings, the source being Noetherian), for every prime $\mathfrak r\subseteq\mathfrak Q$ of $S[x]$ the formal fibre $(S[x]_{\mathfrak Q})^\wedge\otimes_{S[x]}\kappa(\mathfrak r)$ is geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak r)$.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Proposition Tag 07PV (proposition-finite-type-over-G-ring), paragraphs 2-5 (lines 12596-12637): 'Let R be a Noetherian complete local ring and let q in R[x] be a maximal ideal lying over the maximal ideal of R ...'; that argument uses Lemma 07PN (lemma-check-G-ring-easy), Lemma 07PP (lemma-G-ring-goes-up-quasi-finite), Algebra Lemma 032D (lemma-complete-local-Noetherian-domain-finite-over-regular), Algebra Lemma 07NF (lemma-regular-goes-up), Lemma 07NY (lemma-completion-regular), Lemma 07PR (lemma-helper-G-ring) and Lemma 07PU (lemma-another-helper-G-ring). No tag of its own: it is the 'right vertical arrow' step of 07PV, stated here as a node.
